mission.title: litellm: [Bug]: /ui/chat returns 404 — Next.js static export missing index.html in chat/ directory
mission.description: [Bug]: /ui/chat returns 404 — Next.js static export missing index.html in chat/ directory. This issue affects 26+ users.

steps.title: Identify litellm troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your litellm deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm -n litellm --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review litellm configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant litellm configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm
kubectl get configmap -n litellm -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=litellm
```
### Check for existing issues

### What happened?

Direct navigation to `/ui/chat` (or any UI sub-route like `/ui/logs`, `/ui/models-and-endpoints`) returns `{"detail":"Not Found"}` (HTTP 404).

steps.title: Apply the fix for [Bug]: /ui/chat returns 404 — Next.js static export missing…
steps.description:
Apply the configuration change to resolve the issue:
```yaml
kubectl port-forward litellm-0 14000:4000

curl http://localhost:14000/ui/       → 200 ✅ (25528 bytes)
curl http://localhost:14000/ui/chat   → 404 ❌ ({"detail":"Not Found"})
curl http://localhost:14000/ui/chat/  → 404 ❌ ({"detail":"Not Found"})
```

steps.title: Confirm [Bug]: /ui/chat returns 404 — Next.js static… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=litellm -n litellm --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n litellm --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.

resolution.summary: See the source issue for the community-verified solution: https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/issues/24037
codeSnippets:
kubectl port-forward litellm-0 14000:4000

curl http://localhost:14000/ui/       → 200 ✅ (25528 bytes)
curl http://localhost:14000/ui/chat   → 404 ❌ ({"detail":"Not Found"})
curl http://localhost:14000/ui/chat/  → 404 ❌ ({"detail":"Not Found"})

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Deploy LiteLLM v1.82.3-stable, v1.82.4-nightly, or main-latest (as of 2026-03-18)
2. Navigate to `<litellm_url>/ui/` → works, dashboard loads
3. Navigate to `<litellm_url>/ui/chat` directly (bookmark, URL bar, refresh while on chat page) → 404

### Proposed Fix

The Next.js static export build step should generate `index.html` inside each page directory, or alternatively add a catch-all route that serves `{page}.html` when `{page}/index.html` is not found.
